subject: Rolling invoice matrix, ledger handoff & tax residency checklist
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme-analytics.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT / tax residency questions

Hi David,

Thanks again for yesterday's call — we got internal sign-off on the committed spend number. Procurement asked me to confirm a few operational items before we kick off:

- We need a staggered invoice plan (quarterly invoices against the annual prepay) with an expected drawdown schedule so our treasury team can plan wire dates.
- For VAT purposes, we need a clear statement of Redwood's supply location and whether invoices should be VAT-exempt or include UK/EU VAT.
- Our finance team will require a list of contact people and a sample invoice layout so we can map fields into our AP system.

Can you send a proposed invoice matrix (dates, amounts, GL-friendly descriptions) and a VAT/residency checklist? Ideally by COB Monday so we can route internally.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Turner
Head of Procurement
Acme Analytics

-----Original Message-----

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT / tax residency questions

Thanks Sophie — quick reply, and we will follow up with attachments.

Summary of what we'll provide:
- A proposed invoice matrix (attached .xlsx) implementing a quarterly drawdown aligned to your fiscal quarters; each invoice will carry a unique invoice number and GL-friendly description.
- A VAT / tax residency checklist (.pdf) that explains Redwood's supply location model and the evidence we accept (POI, VAT registration, business registration).
- A sample PDF invoice that shows the line-level breakdown (tokens/units, discounts, VAT line).

Action owners: Lauren (Finance) will confirm the billing entity and VAT treatment; Priyom (Sales Ops) will produce the invoice numbering and HubSpot mapping; Kimberly (Customer Success / Onboarding) will handle AP field mapping and test invoice exchange.

I'll drop the files into a shared Drive link and also attach them here for speed. Let us know if you need DocuSign for the amended SOW or just a signed confirmation email.

Cheers,
David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2025Q4-invoice-matrix.xlsx; vat-residency-checklist.pdf; sample-invoice-ACME-001.pdf

Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT / tax residency questions

Quick notes from Finance after scanning Sophie's ask:

- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Ltd. (UK entity) will issue invoices to Acme EU on net-30 unless you request otherwise. That means standard UK VAT rules may apply unless Acme provides valid VAT registration and proof of business presence.
- Evidence we need from Acme to consider zero-rated intra‑EU B2B supply: VAT registration number + a copy of the buyer’s VAT certificate and the PO that references the ACME account. If they provide VAT ID + EU business registration, we can zero-rate.
- For customers in the UK (post‑Brexit): if Acme's billing address is UK, include UK VAT at the applicable rate.

I've updated the attached vat-residency-checklist.pdf with the required evidence fields. Priyom — once Sophie confirms the schedule, please confirm the invoice numbering pattern (e.g., ACME-2025-Q4-001) so our AR system can accept automated matches.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance
Redwood Inference

- Quarterly invoices (Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1) are fine. Please confirm the first invoice net amount and the wiring window (we will schedule ACH 7-10 business days after invoice date).
- We will provide VAT registration + PO by Friday; can you confirm you accept the PO as the contractual reference for the invoice?
- DocuSign: we need the SOW amendment signed. Please send the DocuSign link and we'll route to Liam (CFO).

If all good I'll mark HS-938472 as ready-to-approve on our side.

Best,
